prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on what you need. To give you a useful recommendation I need a few details. Quick questions:

1. What services do you need? (e.g., SEO, paid media, social, branding, PR, content, B2B demand gen, web design)  
2. What industry are you in? (tech, healthcare, nonprofits, retail, real estate, etc.)  
3. Company size and budget? (startup with $1–5k/mo, mid‑market $5–25k/mo, enterprise)  
4. Do you need a local Maryland firm (onsite meetings) or is remote OK?  
5. Any must-have outcomes or KPIs? (lead volume, ROI, brand awareness, app installs)

What I can do next:
- Provide a shortlist of top Maryland agencies matched to your needs (with specialties, sample clients, strengths, and estimated pricing).  
- Or give a checklist you can use to evaluate agencies yourself.

Tell me the answers above and I’ll pull a tailored list.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
